versions.changelog:
Initial release of auto-design—an intelligent skill for auto-selecting and applying design systems based on context.

- Automatically detects project type, tech stack, and user intent to recommend appropriate design systems.
- Supports override via user requests or environment variables.
- Downloads design blueprints from the awesome-design-md library and generates local DESIGN.md references.
- Handles a wide range of project types like developer tools, AI/ML products, documentation, marketing sites, and dashboards.
- Includes detailed trigger conditions and a robust selection algorithm with fallback options.
- Provides cross-platform compatibility instructions, especially for Claude Code users.
